title: VTAM: Efficient Visuo-Tactile World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation without Tactile Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2603.23481v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tactile vision-language-action models (VLAs) and tactile world-action models (WAMs) are a promising new paradigm for contact-rich manipulation, but existing models either underutilize touch, rely on large-scale tactile pretraining, or incur high inference latency due to iterative video generation. We present VTAM, an efficient visuo-tactile world-action model for contact-rich manipulation that requires no tactile or action pretraining. RGB and tactile observations share a frozen video VAE and the pretrained video transformer weights. VTAM first adapts the video backbone to jointly predict future visual and tactile latents, then fine-tunes it end-to-end with a randomly initialized action expert that predicts actions, proprioceptive states, and a light flow-force proxy computed from tactile optical flow. translated_title: VTAM：无需触觉预训练的高效视觉-触觉世界-动作模型，用于富接触操作
translated_abstract: 触觉视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）和触觉世界-动作模型（WAMs）是富接触操作的一种有前景的新范式，但现有模型要么未能充分利用触觉信息，要么依赖大规模触觉预训练，要么因迭代式视频生成而产生较高的推理延迟。我们提出了VTAM，一种用于富接触操作的高效视觉-触觉世界-动作模型，它无需触觉或动作预训练。RGB和触觉观测共享一个冻结的视频VAE以及预训练的视频transformer权重。VTAM首先将视频主干网络适配为联合预测未来的视觉和触觉潜在表示，然后与一个随机初始化的动作专家一起进行端到端微调，该动作专家负责预测动作、本体感知状态，以及一个由触觉光流计算得到的轻量级流-力代理信号。仅使用任务演示数据进行训练，VTAM在两个平台上的四个真实机器人任务中超越了所有基线，这些平台具有不同的……
tldr: VTAM提出了一种无需触觉或动作预训练的高效视觉-触觉世界-动作模型，通过共享冻结的视频VAE并联合预测未来视觉与触觉潜在表示，在富接触操作的真实机器人任务上超越了所有基线。
en_tdlr: VTAM is an efficient visuo-tactile world-action model requiring no tactile or action pretraining, which jointly predicts future visual and tactile latents by sharing a frozen video VAE and outperforms all baselines on contact-rich real-robot manipulation tasks.
